preflight.purpose: setup and throughput check with the same config except the 16,384-transition budget

runtime_notes: Training overlapped checkpoint evaluation; wall time is not an isolated throughput benchmark.
Memory fields are PyTorch allocation/reservation and process RSS; not total GPU PhysX memory.
Raw training transitions are not recorded individually. Full raw trajectories are in independent checkpoint evaluation.
The eight evaluation seeds repeat one fixed scene. No multi-seed training or geometry generalization claim.
